title: Meal Prep
shortDescription: Plan the week's family dinners from NYT Cooking recipes you share.
fullDescription:
Meal Prep is a small meal-planning app made for one family of four. It connects to the household's own home server; the app only talks to that server, and nothing is shared with anyone else.

What it does now:
• Share a recipe from the NYT Cooking app: tap Share, choose Meal Prep, and pick the week it's for. Weeks run Sunday to Saturday, and the upcoming week is selected for you.
• The recipe is imported in the background by the home server and added to that week. If you're away from home, the share waits and is sent once you're back on the home network.
• This week at a glance: one row per night, Sunday to Saturday, with recipes that aren't on a night yet waiting in a tray at the top. Tap or drag a recipe onto a night, scale it up for leftovers, or take it off the week.
• Swipe between weeks to plan ahead.
• A copy of the week is saved on the phone, so the plan is still readable when the server can't be reached.

Coming later:
• Building a grocery pickup cart for Loblaws (PC Express) from the week's recipes
• A Sunday prep checklist
• Cook cards for each night
• Rating how each meal went

Meal Prep needs the household's Meal Prep server and does nothing without it. It is not a public service.

Not affiliated with The New York Times or Loblaws.
